154:t_038:2.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The $$ユニコーン$$ appears to have taken $$ミネバ・ザビ$$ under its protection!」

154:t_038:3.en:
$$レイアム$$
「But at that position, we can't recover it...!」

154:t_038:4.en:
$$カガリ$$
「$c! We'll deal with that white unit on our end!」

154:t_039:1.en:
$$カガリ$$
「We'll launch the shuttle with the mass driver! Go up into space with it!」

154:t_040:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! You come along too!」

154:t_040:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Please look after $$バナージ$$!」

154:t_040:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リディ$$! Don't lose yourself!」

154:t_040:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Remember how your fight began!」

154:t_040:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're a man, aren't you, Ensign $$リディ$$! Where did the man who challenged me to a fair fight go!」

154:t_040:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, return! The $$サイデリアル$$ are about to move!」

154:t_041:0.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Mass driver, activate! Launch the shuttle!」

154:t_041:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Don't think I'll let you go right before my eyes!」

154:t_042:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ngh...! I got a late start!」

154:t_044:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Damn...! I still can't catch up, even with the $$デルタプラス$$'s acceleration...!」

154:t_044:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is this as far as you go, $$ユニコーン$$!? Your potential...!」

154:t_044:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I have to do it...! $$オードリー$$ is in here too!!」

154:t_045:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ユニコーン$$...! It's accelerating from here!?」

154:t_046:0.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Is this all right, General $$ダバラーン$$? Doing something that lets $c slip away...」

154:t_046:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「My mission is to detain the dignitaries on that island. I won't be told I have no right to do so.」

154:t_046:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Besides, isn't it worth watching? How far those people can get in this hopeless situation.」

154:t_046:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Now, we move out. We will land and receive the ladies.」

154:t_046:6.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「You must not show a frightened face, $$ナナリー$$.」

154:t_046:7.en:
$$カガリ$$
「We have surrendered, but that doesn't mean we are handing our hearts over to them.」

154:t_046:8.en:
$$マリナ$$
「Let us believe in the people to whom we entrusted our hope.」

154:t_046:10.en:
$$カガリ$$
(I'm counting on you, $c... So that the Earth can greet the dawn.)

154:t_047:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「This pilot...! How unpleasant!」

154:t_047:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The one riding that is...!」

154:t_047:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is that you, $$マリーダ$$!?」

154:t_047:4.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「I am $$プルトゥエルブ$$!」

154:t_048:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「With her memory controlled, she's forgotten even that she fought alongside us!」

154:t_048:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll keep calling out until I reach $$マリーダ$$! I can't let her die in a place like this!」

154:t_048:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「For Captain $$ジンネマン$$'s sake, too...!」

154:t_049:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Remember, $$マリーダ$$! Us... and Captain $$ジンネマン$$!」

154:t_049:1.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「I am $$プルトゥエルブ$$! I know no $$マリーダ$$!」

154:t_049:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It's not that you don't know! You just can't remember!」

154:t_049:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Isn't that name of yours something the Captain gave you!?」

154:t_049:4.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「Shut up... shut up! You're the enemy...! The Gundam is the enemy!!」

154:t_049:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Get away, $$バナージ$$! Destroy Mode is activating!」

154:t_050:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Now that Destroy Mode has activated, her consciousness is completely dominated by the machine!」

154:t_050:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is she the same as I was back then...!」

154:t_050:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We stop the black $$ユニコーン$$, $$バナージ$$! Saving her comes after that!」

154:t_051:0.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Damn! Is this as far as we go!?」

154:t_052:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Damn! They broke through the first line of defense!」

154:t_052:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$カガリ$$ and the others are still safe! Let's make sure we stop the enemies approaching the residence, one by one!」

154:t_100:0.en:
$$リディ$$
($$ミネバ$$... At the very least, I'll protect you...)

154:t_100:1.en:
$$リディ$$
(I don't give a damn about the family or the Box...! I'll just find a place where you and I can live!)

154:t_101:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$カガリ$$ and the others are trying to fulfill their own responsibilities too...! Without ever running away...!」

154:t_101:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「I have resolve, too...! The resolve not to run away from fighting!」

154:t_102:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Listen, pilot of the black $$ユニコーン$$! That machine is dangerous!」

154:t_102:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The NT-D System turns the person riding it into a machine for fighting! That's why...!」

154:t_102:5.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「The Gundam is the enemy! I will defeat my Master's enemy!」

154:t_103:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$マリーダ$$! If you can't stop fighting, I'll destroy that machine!」

154:t_103:1.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「This $$バンシィ$$ is the power my Master gave me! As if someone like you could stop it!」

154:t_103:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll do it anyway! For Captain $$ジンネマン$$'s sake too!」

154:t_104:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「A Gundam piloted by a $$ニュータイプ$$! That existence is my Master's enemy!」

154:t_104:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「How many times will people repeat the same mistake before they're satisfied...!」
